description: Frost and freeze dates — Average last spring and first fall freeze dates for a US place from NOAA 1991-2020 normals at 36F (frost), 32F, 28F and 24F: median dates, 90%-safe planting date, early-risk fall date, growing season length, plus planting advice. Optional date=YYYY-MM-DD rates the freeze risk on that day (LOW / MODERATE / HIGH / VERY HIGH). Params: place= or lat=&lon=. Example output used date=2027-04-05. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: weather_frost_dates
